lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Reward: Box of Soda ×2

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I've received your report.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: It's a shame you didn't find her.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: The runaway Commander will be marked as killed in today's operation.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Thanks for your hard work.
Who is that Commander anyway?

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Why do you ask?
Just curious.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Her name was Jane Miller.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: She became a Commander three years ago, and has lost every battle since.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: She had recently failed again, and the Central Government was planning to dismiss her from her post.
What does that have to do with her runaway?

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Commanders don't necessarily lose their jobs after being dismissed.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: The Central Government usually gives most of them

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: new jobs that are more suitable for them.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: So the dismissal would be an illogical reason for her to run away.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: In any case, there's no way of knowing the truth now.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Anyway, we've talked about it for long enough,

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: now it's time for me to knock off.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Goodbye.
